minecraft:written_book_content.title: A Lantern for Both Shores
minecraft:written_book_content.author: The Petal Cartographers
pages: {"text":"","extra":[{"text":"A","font":"uwudimension:lore_sketches"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"\ue229","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"Contents","color":"#713a55","underlined":true,"clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}},{"text":"\ue202","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"\ue180","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"\n\n","By the third night of rain, the bridge was gone. A Petal keeper saved its planks. A Dusk keeper saved its pegs. Each waited on a different bank."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"B","font":"uwudimension:lore_sketches"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"\ue257","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"\ue180","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"\n\n","Anya, Goddess of Cupids, now tended the shores her Cupid father had guarded before his ascent. A lamp mender lit her wick. Anya asked who was stranded."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"C","font":"uwudimension:lore_sketches"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"\ue259","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"\ue180","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"\n\n","The first plank came from Petal. The first peg came from Dusk. By dawn, their families crossed. Together they hung a lantern where their work met."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"D","font":"uwudimension:lore_sketches"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"\ue258","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"\ue180","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"\n\n","When the sky cleared, a glint showed beneath Anya's cloak: ivory wings, pink ribbon, and a golden-rimmed heart. The keepers learned its name: the Cupid Bow."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:lantern_below","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","Anya covered the flame. Three knocks rose through the planks. A child tapped back with a supper spoon. A fourth knock answered."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:lantern_below","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","A Petal keeper lent a cracked bell. A Dusk keeper tied on fishing line. They lowered it and rang. A blue light bobbed behind the falls."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:lantern_below","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","Beyond the falls, a roof hung point-down from the stone. The gallery below stood level. Anya heard a spoon striking the rail."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:lantern_below","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","A ferryman raised his blue lamp. "I saw the bridge. I couldn't see the steps." The child shared her dumplings. Nobody minded the cold supper."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:lantern_below","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","They hung the bell beneath the bridge. In the Tide Archive a keeper wrote, "When you map the Inverted Shrine, mark the way home, too.""]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:the_ferry_map","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","They found Gran under a cherry tree, peeling a pear in one long curl. Her kettle sang. "I know that sound even in fog," the boy said."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:the_ferry_map","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","Mio lent him her pencil. He drew the bench a little too big and the kettle as big as a house. Mio started to rub it out, then stopped."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:the_ferry_map","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","The lamp mender followed the kettle straight to Gran's bench. Gran cut a pear four ways. On Mio's map, the kettle stayed enormous."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:one_knock_late","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","In the cherrywood belfry, a woman in Mio's coat waved. Even the ink stain on her cuff matched. Mio kept both hands in her pockets."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:one_knock_late","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","Back at the lodestone, they took the ladder down. Below the roots hung a second pagoda, all violet glass and black stone. Its last roof faced the void."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:one_knock_late","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","The tunnel rolled over in Mio's eyes. Her boots struck the boards above her head. "We're upside down," the ferryman said. He felt for her sleeve."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:one_knock_late","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","Nearly five hundred blocks under the hill, the void filled the last window. Mio felt for her pencil. A hand in her own ink-stained cuff held it out."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:one_knock_late","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","On every stair stood another Mio or another ferryman. Even their blue lamps matched. Mio knocked the rail. One beat later, the mimics knocked back."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:one_knock_late","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","Mio lunged left. As the mimics leaned after her, she tugged the ferryman right, through a gate. Her own face peered through as she slid the bolt."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:one_knock_late","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","Back at the ferry, Mio inked the gate on her map. Below it she wrote, "If I offer you a pencil on the last landing, keep yours.""]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:the_side_door","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","In the fourth room, Mio stepped onto the wall. Her boots held. The ferryman stood on the floor. They tipped their heads to look each other in the eye."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:the_side_door","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","A cherrywood door hung high overhead, its doormat fastened to the ceiling. The ferryman tried his longest boat pole. The tip missed by a thumb."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:the_side_door","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","Mio let out some thread. Near one pale tile, the end hung sideways. Near the next, it pointed to the ceiling. She wound it in and took a step."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:the_side_door","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","From wall to ceiling she walked. Upside down, she found the mat beneath her boots and the latch at elbow height. She held the door for her friend."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:the_side_door","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","In the hundredth room they opened the tin. Two rice balls clung to the lid. Mio turned it over and set it between them. "There," she said. "A table.""]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:crooked_hinge","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





",""You have to lift the latch a little," she said. The lamp mender already had it open. "Oh," said Anya. She set a second cup of tea on the stove."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:crooked_hinge","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





",""I can straighten it." Anya shut the latch. Click, click. As a child she'd heard that sound from bed and known her father was home."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:crooked_hinge","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





",""Just the wick, please." The mender trimmed its black tip. When Anya closed the crooked door again, the flame held steady."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:crooked_hinge","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","Outside, a boy held a cold candle under his coat. His kitchen fire was out. Anya drew up a stool and set the lantern where he could reach it."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:crooked_hinge","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





",""Lift it a little," Anya told him. Two clicks. His candle caught. Over their tea they watched one gold dot cross the street and climb the stairs."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:first_fare","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





",""Is it meant to do that?" The lid had begun to hop. "Sometimes it sings," the ferryman said. Anya sat beside it to listen."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:first_fare","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","Halfway across, a bubble of dough squeezed out with a squeak. Anya caught it on her thumb. From the far bank someone called, "Don't let her out!""]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:first_fare","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","A Dusk baker took the pot. "When my sister and I opened our own shops, we split the bowls and pans. But we both wanted Gran's bread crock.""]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:first_fare","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





",""Who kept it?" Anya asked. The baker hung the pink scarf beside her purple one. "It's Friday. Today it's mine. On Monday it sails home.""]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:first_fare","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","That evening two loaves came to the ferry, one from each bank. The ferryman cut a heel from each. "Round trip," he said, and passed Anya the butter."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:night_kite","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





",""Who'll see a black kite at night?" Anya asked. The girl pointed to the kiln across the river. "My brother fires the pots. He misses every fair.""]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:night_kite","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","The first throw sent the crow beak-first into the grass. "He does that," the girl said. Anya held the reel while she shifted the knot."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:night_kite","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","This time the string hummed. Up went the crow, until Anya could hardly see it. At the kiln window, the girl's brother was still bent over his work."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:night_kite","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","The moon edged over the ridge. The girl let out string, a little at a time. When the black wings crossed its face, her brother looked up."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:night_kite","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","Three notes came across the water. In the lit window her brother held up a little clay bird. The girl dipped one paper wing. He played it again."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:kiln_watch","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","Caw. Caw. Anya looked up. A black crow sat on the village gate. It wiped its beak on the beam and settled its feathers as they walked under."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:kiln_watch","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","Her brother already had his coat on. Still he stood beside his stool, rubbing clay from his hands. From behind the iron kiln door came a tiny ping."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:kiln_watch","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





",""They sing while they cool," he said. "Somebody has to sit up with them." Anya drew the stool under her. "I'm somebody. Off you go.""]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:kiln_watch","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





","From the window she saw the kite rise, dip out of sight, then rise again. A pot gave a ping. Anya tapped her cup with a spoon and waited for a reply."]}

{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:kiln_watch","color":"#ffffff"},{"text":"","extra":[{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation"},{"text":"","font":"uwudimension:book_navigation","color":"#ffffff","clickEvent":{"action":"change_page","value":"53"},"hoverEvent":{"action":"show_text","contents":{"text":"Open chapter contents"}}}]},"





",""I flew it," the potter said when they came back. Grass on both knees, string up one sleeve. "And the landing?" Anya asked. His sister picked a leaf from his hair."]}
